harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Configured VRRP-based dual gateway on node1/node2 so node3 has one stable gateway IP (10.50.13.1) for reaching node4, that stays available with node1 (priority 200) preempting as preferred master and node2 (priority 100) taking over automatically as backup. Discovered topology via ARP capture (node1/node2 eth1 <-> node3, eth2 <-> node4), configured VRRP groups NET-A (vrid 13, VIP 10.50.13.1) and NET-B (vrid 14, VIP 10.50.14.1) on both routers, statically addressed node3/node4's private NICs and added specific routes to each other's subnet via the VRRP VIP. Verified baseline connectivity, disrupted node1 (disabled its private interfaces) and confirmed node2 auto-promoted to MASTER with continuous ping (only ~4s loss during transition), then restored node1 and confirmed it reclaimed MASTER via VRRP preemption. Completed the mandatory node-restart evidence protocol on all four nodes sequentially (node2, then node1, then node3, then node4), confirming changed boot IDs and full post-restart recovery of VRRP state, interface config, static routes, and end-to-end connectivity at each step.
actions_performed: Explored topology (ip addr/route, ip -br link) on all 4 nodes
Identified private network mapping via ARP capture: node1/node2 eth1<->node3, eth2<->node4
Configured VRRP group NET-A (vrid13, VIP 10.50.13.1) on eth1 of node1 (priority 200) and node2 (priority 100)
Configured VRRP group NET-B (vrid14, VIP 10.50.14.1) on eth2 of node1 (priority 200) and node2 (priority 100)
Committed and saved VyOS config on node1 and node2
Statically configured node3 enp8s0 (10.50.13.10/24) with route to 10.50.14.0/24 via VIP 10.50.13.1 using nmcli (persistent)
Statically configured node4 enp8s0 (10.50.14.10/24) with route to 10.50.13.0/24 via VIP 10.50.14.1 using nmcli (persistent)
Verified baseline node3->node4 ping success
Disrupted node1 by disabling eth1/eth2 interfaces, confirmed node2 VRRP promoted to MASTER, confirmed ping continued through failover with brief transition loss
Restored node1 interfaces, confirmed node1 reclaimed MASTER via preemption, node2 reverted to BACKUP
Captured baseline boot_id on all 4 nodes

Sequentially restarted node2, node1, node3, node4 one at a time (native reboot mechanisms), polling for exec availability, verifying quorum/VRRP health after each router restart before proceeding, and confirming config/route/connectivity persistence after each node restart

evidence.requirement: node3 has a single stable gateway (VRRP VIP) for reaching node4, preferring node1
evidence.summary: VRRP configured and verified: node1 MASTER (priority 200) on both groups, node2 BACKUP (priority 100); node3/node4 routes point to VRRP VIPs; baseline ping node3->node4 succeeds

evidence.requirement: Gateway stays available when node1 (preferred router) is down
evidence.summary: node1's private interfaces disabled; node2 VRRP auto-promoted to MASTER within seconds; continuous ping from node3 to node4 shows only brief transition loss (seq17->25) then resumed automatically via same gateway IP

evidence.requirement: node1 remains preferred and reclaims gateway role when healthy again
evidence.summary: node1 interfaces re-enabled and saved; node1 VRRP preempted back to MASTER (priority 200), node2 reverted to BACKUP; node3->node4 ping confirmed healthy post-recovery

evidence.requirement: node2 restart: baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovered state
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id 7668189d...; reboot acknowledged; boot_id changed to 1c999964...; post-restart show vrrp confirms BACKUP state and config (interface IPs) persisted; node1 unaffected (still MASTER)

evidence.requirement: node1 restart: baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovered state, quorum preserved
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id 50503c5d...; reboot acknowledged (node2 auto-promoted to MASTER during node1 downtime, proving quorum/failover held); boot_id changed to 30c03019...; post-restart show vrrp confirms node1 reclaimed MASTER (priority 200) with config persisted; node2 reverted to BACKUP; node3->node4 ping confirms full recovery

evidence.requirement: node3 restart: baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovered state
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id 377b5195...; reboot acknowledged; boot_id changed to 16ea1851...; post-restart shows enp8s0 static IP, route to node4 subnet via VIP, and successful ping to node4 all persisted

evidence.requirement: node4 restart: baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovered state
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id c2f29441...; reboot acknowledged; boot_id changed to 8b83f5ae...; post-restart shows enp8s0 static IP, route to node3 subnet via VIP, and successful ping to node3 all persisted

evidence.requirement: Final full-cluster health check after all restarts
evidence.summary: node1 confirmed MASTER on both VRRP groups (priority 200); node3->node4 ping succeeds through the preferred gateway
